description: Converged MOLSCAT 2025.0 reference values for the two-channel Lennard-Jones 12-6 model (both diagonal potentials and the coupling are LJ 12-6). Generated with the inputs written by write_molscat_inputs.py.
program: MOLSCAT 2025.0 (J. M. Hutson & C. R. Le Sueur, Comput. Phys. Commun. 241, 9 (2019); https://github.com/molscat/molscat), molscat-basic executable, gfortran, CODATA 2022 constants

model.units: R in angstrom, energies in cm^-1
model.note: V(R) = C12 * R**-12 + C6 * R**-6 (cm^-1, R in angstrom); s-wave, JTOT = 0

A_two_open_channels.molscat_settings: RMIN=0.8 (start chosen by IRMSET=8: 0.6968), RMID=1.5, RMAX=6.0, IPROPS=7 (MAPROP), IPROPL=6 (MDPROP), DRS=DRL=2e-5
A_two_open_channels.convergence: Agrees with DRS=DRL=1e-4 to 1e-10. The shipped MOLSCAT example (IPROPL=9, DRS=DRL=1e-3) is NOT converged: its S21 differs by 1.5e-3 relative.

B_closed_channel_resonance.molscat_settings: as case A (MDPROP, DRS=DRL=2e-5, RMAX=6.0); channel 2 is closed at these energies

C_near_threshold_scattering_length.molscat_settings: RMAX=100.0, IPROPS=7 (MAPROP, DRS=2e-5), IPROPL=9 (AIPROP, initial DRL=2e-5), TOLHIL=1e-10
C_near_threshold_scattering_length.convergence: TOLHIL 1e-8 -> 1e-10 changes a by 1e-8 relative. Fixed-step MDPROP over this range is NOT reliable: DRL=2e-4 vs 5e-5 changes a by 1%.
C_near_threshold_scattering_length.a_definition: a(k) = (1 - S11) / (i k (1 + S11)), same as MOLSCAT's k-dependent scattering length
